candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Count each distinct pickup timestamp first, then combine counts by hour. Cast the sum to preserve the original BIGINT type.
candidates.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1
